sequence.x: Put some water in a glass or metal dish and place it in the sunlight.
Add a few drops of black ink to the water.
Cover the dish with a transparent glass or polythene sheet.
Leave it in the sunlight for 15-20 minutes. You will see droplets of water condensing on the inner surface of the glass or sheet.
Ask the students to note the colour of the condensed water drops. They may taste these water drops.
Repeat the experiment using salt water. Does the condensed water taste salty?

extension.x: 1. Ask students how they will obtain drinking water from sea water.

discussion.x: How do evaporation and condensation take place in this activity? Is the formation of droplets of water on the glass sheet related to formation of clouds?
